description: E3 (decision E3-4): an iron stake as tall as a tower, driven into a boulder on the Kingsward's edge, where the old kings rooted the oath-chains that bind the last king's armour to its watch. Only a stage-9 giant (116 ft) can heave it out of the rock: the chains go slack, and the Hollow Titan's torn plates are drawn back onto him only half as fast (world.kingsward.stake_pulled). A smaller giant cannot move it.
locked_message: It will not move. Only a giant of a hundred and sixteen feet could heave it out of the rock. Grow to stage 9.
